annotations.title: Study a style reference's video again

description: Ask the server to study a reference's uploaded video again (ffmpeg; it takes up to a minute), then read the result with style_reference_get. Pass at_s (up to 12 seconds) for a sheet of exactly those moments: a caption's animation, a transition, a punch-in. Without at_s it redoes the overview. Links can't be studied: the server never opens them, so ask the person for a screen recording and add it with media_id.

at_s.description: Seconds into the video to put on the sheet.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.
